name: p2-hold-right-hold-jump
description: ATTACK: the two-key policy. Hold ArrowRight and hold Space for the entire run and never touch anything else — zero timing, zero route choice, zero fire. This targets the launch-on-contact rule: src/pure/traversal.js reads jumpBuffered as (jumpBufferedUntil > now || keys.jump), so a HELD jump key converts every ledge catch and every wall contact into a full-power launch with no input at all. The jump buffer itself only fires once (src/main.js buffers on keydown with !e.repeat), so any height beyond the first jump has to come from contact launches. If this clears the slice, route choice is decorative.
